title: Reuse the coverage producer's stage list when its hash matches
body:
## Summary
- The coverage checker parses `research/complex-sw4-frame8/verify.py` on every contract read. That producer names 22 top-level `run` stages.
- Reusing the stage list when the source hash matches makes one hundred reads more than twice as fast. The cached list equals a fresh parse, and a changed producer is parsed again.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. The frontier coverage command is not run.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/replay-ast-cache/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/replay-ast-cache/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/replay-ast-cache`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
